notes: GAAP city, FY ended 12/31/2024. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances p6 (Total Governmental Funds). Other financing = long-term lease 494,174 + premium 12,514,692 + sale of capital assets 4,969,923; issuance of debt 147,730,000 in debt_proceeds. Roll-forward 357,039,510 + 855,942,839 - 906,705,527 + 37,132,606 - 96,145,738 + 147,730,000 + 17,978,789 = 412,972,479. ending_cash = cash and pooled investments 208,605,474 (governmental funds balance sheet p5); investments 199,785,344 informational. 'Other public services' is mixed (solid waste dominant) -> utilities. Business-type from the proprietary statements pp7-11 (Total Proprietary Funds): operating revenues split by activity using the Statement of Activities p3 charges (sum = 247,089,612 on p9); expenses by cost type with function utilities; loss on sale 7,103 recorded as a business-type expense so totals equal the p3 business-type expenses 162,298,962; capital contributions 3,374,907 in business_type.other_financing; transfers net 59,013,131 (p4). Roll-forward 1,122,487,639 + 261,600,429 - 162,298,962 + 59,013,131 + 3,374,907 = 1,284,177,144. Internal balances net to zero in the Total column (not listed). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column pp1-2; long-term liabilities include net pension/OPEB (not split). Detail: budgetary-basis budget-to-actual schedules for the General Fund (pp12-13) and 18 other governmental funds (p14, pp17-33); budgetary actuals differ from the GAAP statement (basis differences). Ballpark Revenue Fund has only a transfer in. No supplementary schedules for the proprietary funds, so no business-type detail. Pages 15-16 (civilian pension RSI) and 34-36 (statistical schedules) have no financial detail. Transfer cross-check: GOCVB out 313,504 = Destination Marketing in 313,504; other transfers have no counterpart on the trimmed pages. Read pages 1-36 of 36
